_meta.description: Per-CUI classification of all 2,646 ROCOv2 / ImageCLEFmedical 2026 concepts into concept_taxonomy.json. One (category, subcategory) per concept; order matches concepts_for_claude.txt. For building the label DAG (hierarchical loss, child->parent propagation, hierarchy-aware metrics).
_meta.method: Deterministic priority-ordered keyword classifier (Imaging Modality > Device & Intervention > Pathology > Radiological Finding > Clinical Context > Anatomy), negation-aware disease matching, organ-system + precise vertebra guards, then hand-curated overrides incl. a UMLS semantic-type cross-audit pass; see classify.py.
